rationale: Stonepeak's own materials classify the assets as supply-chain real estate with infrastructure-like characteristics, managed by its Real Estate team. The disclosed activity consists of warehouse acquisitions, leasing and asset management; no distinct company operating terminals, intermodal systems, cargo handling, freight or other infrastructure services was identified. The display label is therefore an out-of-scope manager/property-program label, not a direct infrastructure PortCo.
recommendedChanges: Exclude Stonepeak Infrastructure Logistics Platform from the direct infrastructure-equity PortCo census.
Do not create an operating-company record or infer a 100% Stonepeak ownership stake from manager-branded property acquisitions.
Preserve the warehouse acquisitions, Omni asset sale and real-estate fund lineage as excluded real-estate history.
Keep operating logistics companies such as TRAC Intermodal separate from this property program.
Do not count individual warehouses, portfolios or property SPVs as separate PortCos.
unresolvedQuestions: Exact property SPVs and legal continuity between the June 2021 display label and later purchases are not publicly disclosed.
Asset-level funds, co-investors, sellers and stakes are not publicly disclosed.
No primary source for the June 2021 launch or initial close was found.
Consolidated tenants, lease terms and property manager are not publicly disclosed.
